verses.geez: እገኒ፡ ለከ፡ እግዚኦ፡ ንጉሥ፡ ወእሴብሐከ፡ አምላኪየ፡ ወመድኀኒየ፡ ወእትአመን፡ በስምከ።
verses.translation: I will thank thee, O Lord and King, and praise thee, O God my Saviour: I do give praise unto thy name:

translations.lxx: I will thank thee, O Lord and King, and praise thee, O God my Saviour: I do give praise unto thy name:
translations.ron: Mărturisi-mă-voi ţie, Doamne Împărate, şi Te voi lăuda pe Tine, Dumnezeule, Izbăvitorul meu.
translations.grk: Ἐξομολογήσομαι σοι Κύριε βασιλεῦ, καὶ αἰνέσω σε Θεὸν τὸν σωτῆρά μου· ἐξομολογοῦμαι τῷ ὀνόματί σου,

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ኮንከኒ፡ ረዳኤ፡ ወመሰውረ፡ ወቤዘውኮ፡ ለሥጋየ፡ እምነ፡ ሞት፡ ወእምነ፡ መሥገርተ፡ ውድየተ፡ ልሳን፡ ወእምነ፡ አእላፍ፡ እለ፡ ይትጌበርዋ፡ ለሐሰት። በቅድመ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ እለ፡ ቆሙ፡ ላዕሌየ፡ ኮንከኒ፡ ረዳእየ፡ ወመሰውርየ።
verses.translation: for thou art my defender and helper, and hast preserved my body from destruction, and from the snare of the slanderous tongue, and from the lips that forge lies, and hast been mine helper against mine adversaries:

translations.lxx: for thou art my defender and helper, and hast preserved my body from destruction, and from the snare of the slanderous tongue, and from the lips that forge lies, and hast been mine helper against mine adversaries:
translations.ron: Mărturisescu-mă numelui Tău, că acoperitor şi ajutor Te-ai făcut mie şi ai mântuit trupul meu de la pieire.
translations.grk: ὅτι σκεπαστὴς καὶ βοηθὸς ἐγένου μοι, καὶ ἐλυτρώσω τὸ σῶμά μου ἐξ ἀπωλείας, καὶ ἐκ παγίδος διαβολῆς γλώσσης· ἀπὸ χειλέων ἐργαζομένων ψεῦδος, καὶ ἔναντι τῶν παρεστηκότων ἐγένου μοι βοηθὸς,

verses.geez: ወቤዘውከኒ፡ በከመ፡ ብዝኀ፡ ምሕረትከ፡ ወበእንተ፡ ስምከ። ከመ፡ ዘየሐቅዩ፡ ዘአስተዳለዉ፡ ይብልዑ፡ ከማሁ፡ ኀሠሥዋ፡ ለነፍስየ፡ በብዝኀ፡ ሕማም፡ እንተ፡ ረከበተኒ።
verses.translation: and hast delivered me, according to the multitude of thy mercies and greatness of thy name, from the teeth of them that were ready to devour me, and out of the hands of such as sought after my life, and from the manifold afflictions which I had;

translations.lxx: and hast delivered me, according to the multitude of thy mercies and greatness of thy name, from the teeth of them that were ready to devour me, and out of the hands of such as sought after my life, and from the manifold afflictions which I had;
translations.ron: Şi m-ai scăpat din laţul limbii ocărâtoare şi de buzele celor care grăiesc minciună, şi Te-ai făcut mie ajutor împotriva vrăjmaşilor mei.
translations.grk: καὶ ἐλυτρώσω με, κατὰ τὸ πλῆθος ἐλέους καὶ ὀνόματός σου, ἐκ βρυγμῶν ἑτοίμων εἰς βρῶμα, ἐκ χειρὸς ζητούντων τὴν ψυχήν μου, ἐκ πλειόνων θλίψεων ὧν ἔσχον,

verses.geez: ወከመ፡ ዘዐገቶ፡ እሳት፡ ወኢይውዒ፡ በማእከለ፡ እሳት።
verses.translation: from the choking of fire on every side, and from the midst of the fire which I kindled not;

translations.lxx: from the choking of fire on every side, and from the midst of the fire which I kindled not;
translations.ron: Şi m-ai izbăvit pe mine după mulţimea milei şi a numelui Tău, de la cei care răcneau gata să mă mănânce;
translations.grk: ἀπὸ πνιγμοῦ πυρὸς κυκλόθεν, καὶ ἐκ μέσου πυρὸς οὗ οὐκ ἐξέκαυσα,

verses.geez: ወእምታሕቱ፡ እምከርሠ፡ ሞት፡ ወእምልሳን፡ ግሙን፡ ወእምቃለ፡ ሐሰት።
verses.translation: from the depth of the belly of hell, from an unclean tongue, and from lying words.

translations.lxx: from the depth of the belly of hell, from an unclean tongue, and from lying words.
translations.ron: Din mâna celor care căutau sufletul meu, din multe necazuri care le-am avut;
translations.grk: ἐκ βάθους κοιλίας ᾅδου, καὶ ἀπὸ γλώσσης ἀκαθάρτου, καὶ λόγου ψευδοῦς.

verses.geez: ልሳን፡ ዐማፂ፡ ዘያስተዳጕጽ፡ ኀበ፡ ንጉሥ፡ ወአብጽሓ፡ ውስተ፡ ሞት፡ ለ(ሕይወትየ፡ ወለ)ነፍስ፡ ወሕይወትየኒ፡ አልጸቀት፡ ለመቃብር።
verses.translation: By an accusation to the king from an unrighteous tongue my soul drew near even unto death, my life was near to the hell beneath.

translations.lxx: By an accusation to the king from an unrighteous tongue my soul drew near even unto death, my life was near to the hell beneath.
translations.ron: Din înecăciunea fumului de primprejur şi din mijlocul focului pe care nu-l aprinsesem eu;
translations.grk: Βασιλεῖ διαβολὴ γλώσσης ἀδίκου· ᾔγγισεν ἕως θανάτου ἡ ψυχή μου, καὶ ἡ ζωή μου ἦν σύνεγγυς ᾅδου κάτω.

verses.geez: ወዐገቱኒ፡ እምኵለሄ፡ ወኀጣእኩ፡ ረዳኤ፡ ወተናጸርኩ፡ እመቦ፡ ዘይትዔዘበኒ፡ ሰብእ፡ ወአልቦ።
verses.translation: They compassed me on every side, and there was no man to help me: I looked for the succour of men, but there was none.

translations.lxx: They compassed me on every side, and there was no man to help me: I looked for the succour of men, but there was none.
translations.ron: Din adâncul pântecelui locuinţei morţilor şi de limba necurată şi de cuvântul mincinos şi de limba cea nedreaptă cu pâră la împărat.
translations.grk: Περιέσχον με πάντοθεν, καὶ οὐκ ἦν ὁ βοηθῶν· ἐμβλέπων εἰς ἀντίληψιν ἀνθρώπων, καὶ οὐκ ἦν.

verses.geez: ወተዘከርኩ፡ ሣህለከ፡ እግዚኦ፡ ወግብረከኒ፡ ዘእምፍጥረተ፡ ዓለም፡ እስመ፡ ብፁዓን፡ እለ፡ ኪያከ፡ ይሴፈዉ፡ ወታድኅኖሙ፡ እምእደ፡ ፀሮሙ።
verses.translation: Then thought I upon thy mercy, O Lord, and upon thy acts of old, how thou deliverest such as wait for thee, and savest them out of the hands of the enemies.

translations.lxx: Then thought I upon thy mercy, O Lord, and upon thy acts of old, how thou deliverest such as wait for thee, and savest them out of the hands of the enemies.
translations.ron: S-a apropiat până la moarte sufletul meu şi viaţa mea era aproape de fundul împărăţiei morţii.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐμνήσθην τοῦ ἐλέους σου Κύριε, καὶ τῆς ἐργασίας σου τῆς ἀπʼ αἰῶνος· ὅτι ἐξελῇ τοὺς ὑπομένοντάς σε, καὶ σώζεις αὐτοὺς ἐκ χειρὸς ἐθνῶν.

verses.geez: ወአንሣእከኒ፡ እመነ፡ ምድር፡ እምኀጢአትየ፡ ወሰአልኩ፡ ከመ፡ እድኅን፡ እሞት።
verses.translation: Then lifted I up my supplication from the earth, and prayed for deliverance from death.

translations.lxx: Then lifted I up my supplication from the earth, and prayed for deliverance from death.
translations.ron: M-au înconjurat de toate părţile şi nu era cine să-mi ajute, am căutat ajutorul oamenilor şi nu era.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀνύψωσα ἐπὶ γῆς ἱκετείαν μου, καὶ ὑπὲρ θανάτου ῥύσεως ἐδεήθην.

verses.geez: ወእቤሎ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ አቡየ፡ ወእግዚእየ፡ ኢትኅድገኒ፡ አመ፡ ምንዳቤየ፡ በመዋዕለ፡ ዕቡያን፡ ኀበ፡ አልቦ፡ ረድኤት።
verses.translation: I called upon the Lord, the Father of my Lord, that he would not leave me in the days of my trouble, and in the time of the proud, when there was no help.

translations.lxx: I called upon the Lord, the Father of my Lord, that he would not leave me in the days of my trouble, and in the time of the proud, when there was no help.
translations.ron: Şi mi-am adus aminte de mila Ta, Doamne, şi de lucrarea Ta cea din veac.
translations.grk: Ἐπεκαλεσάμην Κύριον πατέρα Κυρίου μου, μή με ἐγκαταλιπεῖν ἐν ἡμέραις θλίψεως, ἐν καιρῷ ὑπερηφάνων ἀβοηθησίας.

verses.geez: ወእሴብሕ፡ ለስምከ፡ ለዝሉፉ፡ ወእገኒ፡ ወአነብብ፡ ወ[ሰ]ምዐኒ፡ ስእለትየ።
verses.translation: I will praise thy name continually, and will sing praise with thanksgiving; and so my prayer was heard:

translations.lxx: I will praise thy name continually, and will sing praise with thanksgiving; and so my prayer was heard:
translations.ron: Că mântuieşti pe cei care Te aşteaptă pe Tine şi-i izbăveşti din mâna vrăjmaşilor.
translations.grk: Αἰνέσω τὸ ὄνομά σου ἐνδελεχῶς, καὶ ὑμνήσω ἐν ἐξομολογήσει· καὶ εἰσηκούσθη ἡ δέησίς μου.

verses.geez: ወአድ[ኅ]ነኒ፡ እሞት፡ ወባልሐኒ፡ እምዕለት፡ እኪት፡ እንበይነ፡ ዝንቱ፡ እገኒ፡ ለከ፡ ወእሴብሐከ፡ ወእባርክ፡ ለስምከ፡ እግዚኦ።
verses.translation: for thou savedst me from destruction, and deliveredst me from the evil time: therefore will I give thanks, and praise thee, and bless thy name, O Lord.

translations.lxx: for thou savedst me from destruction, and deliveredst me from the evil time: therefore will I give thanks, and praise thee, and bless thy name, O Lord.
translations.ron: Şi am înălţat pe pământ rugăciunea mea şi m-am rugat pentru mântuirea mea din moarte.
translations.grk: Ἔσωσας γάρ με ἐξ ἀπωλείας, καὶ ἐξείλου με ἐκ καιροῦ πονηροῦ· διὰ τοῦτο ἐξομολογήσομαι καὶ αἰνέσω σοι, καὶ εὐλογήσω τῷ ὀνόματι Κυρίου·

verses.geez: እንዘ፡ ንኡስ፡ አነ፡ እንበለ፡ እስሐት፡ ኀሠሥክዋ፡ ለጥበብ፡ ወአበደርክዋ፡ በጸሎትየ።
verses.translation: When I was yet young, or ever I went abroad, I desired wisdom openly in my prayer.

translations.lxx: When I was yet young, or ever I went abroad, I desired wisdom openly in my prayer.
translations.ron: Am chemat pe Domnul, Tatăl Domnului meu, ca să nu mă lase fără de ajutor în zilele necazului şi în vreme de jale grea.
translations.grk: Ἔτι ὢν νεώτερος, πρινὴ πλανηθῆναί με, ἐζήτησα σοφίαν προφανῶς ἐν προσευχῇ μου.

verses.geez: ወበቅድመ፡ መቅደስ፡ ሰአልኩ፡ በእንቲአሃ፡ ለዝሉፉ፡ አኀሥሣ።
verses.translation: I prayed for her before the temple, and will seek her out even to the end.

translations.lxx: I prayed for her before the temple, and will seek her out even to the end.
translations.ron: Voi lăuda numele Tău neîncetat şi-l voi cânta întru mărturisire şi s-a auzit rugăciunea mea.
translations.grk: Ἔναντι ναοῦ ἠξίουν περὶ αὐτῆς, καὶ ἕως ἐσχάτων ἐκζητήσω αὐτὴν,

verses.geez: ወሠረጸ፡ ፍሬሃ፡ ከመ፡ ቆዐ፡ ቀምሕ፡ ወተፈሥሐ፡ ልብየ፡ ባቲ፡ ወቆመት፡ እግርየ፡ በጽድቅ፡ ወእምንእስየ፡ ተለውኩ፡ አሠራ።
verses.translation: Even from the flower till the grape was ripe hath my heart delighted in her: my foot went the right way, from my youth up sought I after her.

translations.lxx: Even from the flower till the grape was ripe hath my heart delighted in her: my foot went the right way, from my youth up sought I after her.
translations.ron: Că m-ai izbăvit pe mine din pieire şi m-ai scos din vreme rea.
translations.grk: ἐξ ἄνθους ὡς περκαζούσης σταφυλῆς· εὐφράνθη ἡ καρδία μου ἐν αὐτῇ, ἐπέβη ὁ πούς μου ἐν εὐθύτητι, ἐκ νεότητός μου ἴχνευσα αὐτήν.

verses.geez: ወአፅማእኩ፡ ሕቀ፡ በእዝንየ፡ ወኀረይክዋ፡ ወብዙኀ፡ ጥበበ፡ [ረከብ]ኩ፡ ሊተ።
verses.translation: I bowed down mine ear a little, and received her, and gat much learning.

translations.lxx: I bowed down mine ear a little, and received her, and gat much learning.
translations.ron: Pentru aceea mă voi mărturisi şi Te voi lăuda şi bine voi cuvânta numele Domnului.
translations.grk: Ἔκλινα ὀλίγον τὸ οὖς μου, καὶ ἐδεξάμην, καὶ πολλὴν εὗρον ἐμαυτῷ παιδείαν.

verses.geez: ወኮነኒ፡ ተልዕሎ፡ ባቲ፡ ወእሴብሖ፡ ለዘወሀበኒያ፡ ለጥበብ።
verses.translation: I profited therein, therefore will I ascribe the glory unto him that giveth me wisdom.

translations.lxx: I profited therein, therefore will I ascribe the glory unto him that giveth me wisdom.
translations.ron: Când eram mai tânăr, mai înainte până a nu rătăci, am căutat să am înţelepciunea întru rugăciunea mea.
translations.grk: Προκοπὴ ἐγένετό μοι ἐν αὐτῇ· τῷ διδόντι μοι σοφίαν, δώσω δόξαν.

verses.geez: ወኀለይኩ፡ ከመ፡ እግበራ፡ ወቀናእኩ፡ ለሠናይ፡ ወኢይትኀፈር።
verses.translation: For I purposed to do after her, and earnestly I followed that which is good; so shall I not be confounded.

translations.lxx: For I purposed to do after her, and earnestly I followed that which is good; so shall I not be confounded.
translations.ron: Înaintea sfântului locaş m-am rugat pentru ea şi până la cele de pe urmă o voi căuta pe ea.
translations.grk: Διενοήθην γὰρ τοῦ ποιῆσαι αὐτὴν, καὶ ἐζήλωσα τὸ ἀγαθὸν, καὶ οὐ μὴ αἰσχυνθῶ.

verses.geez: ወተኀየለት፡ ነፍስ፡ባቲ፡ ወጠበብኩ፡ በግብርየ፡ ወአንሣእኩ፡ ላዕለ፡ እደዊየ፡ ወለሐውክዋ፡ ለእበድየ።
verses.translation: My soul hath wrestled with her, and in my doings I was exact: I stretched forth my hands to the heaven above, and bewailed my ignorances of her.

translations.lxx: My soul hath wrestled with her, and in my doings I was exact: I stretched forth my hands to the heaven above, and bewailed my ignorances of her.
translations.ron: Ca de faţa strugurelui copt, aşa s-a veselit inima mea de ea.
translations.grk: Διαμεμάχηται ἡ ψυχή μου ἐν αὐτῇ, καὶ ἐν ποιήσει λιμοῦ διηκριβωσάμην· τὰς χεῖράς μου ἐξεπέτασα πρός ὕψος, καὶ τὰ ἀγνοήματα αὐτῆς ἐπένθησα,

verses.geez: ወአርታዕኩ፡ ነፍስየ፡ በእንቲአሃ፡ ወረከብክዋ፡ በንጹሕ፡ ወአቀምኩ፡ ልብየ፡ ምስሌሃ፡ እምቀዳሚሁ፡ ወእንበይነ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ኢገደፈኒ።
verses.translation: I directed my soul unto her, and I found her in pureness: I have had my heart joined with her from the beginning, therefore shall I not be forsaken.

translations.lxx: I directed my soul unto her, and I found her in pureness: I have had my heart joined with her from the beginning, therefore shall I not be forsaken.
translations.ron: A umblat piciorul meu întru dreptate; din tinereţile mele am căutat-o.
translations.grk: τὴν ψυχήν μου κατεύθυνα εἰς αὐτὴν, καρδίαν ἐκτησάμην μετʼ αὐτῶν ἀπʼ ἀρχῆς, καὶ ἐν καθαρισμῷ εὗρον αὐτήν· διὰ τοῦτο οὐ μὴ ἐγκαταλειφθῶ.

verses.geez: ወከርሥየኒ፡ ተሀውከት፡ ላቲ፡ ወኀሠሠታ፡ እንበይነ፡ ዝንቱ፡ አጥረይኩ፡ ሠናየ፡ ጥሪተ።
verses.translation: My heart was troubled in seeking her: therefore have I gotten a good possession.

translations.lxx: My heart was troubled in seeking her: therefore have I gotten a good possession.
translations.ron: Am plecat puţin urechea mea, şi am primit, şi multă învăţătură am aflat.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἡ κοιλία μου ἐταράχθη ἐκζητῆσαι αὐτήν· διὰ τοῦτο ἐκτησάμην ἀγαθὸν κτῆμα.

verses.geez: ወወሀበኒ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ በልሳንየ፡ ዕሴትየ፡ ወእሴብሖ፡ ባቲ።
verses.translation: The Lord hath given me a tongue for my reward, and I will praise him therewith.

translations.lxx: The Lord hath given me a tongue for my reward, and I will praise him therewith.
translations.ron: Mare folos am avut de la ea; Celui care mi-a dat înţelepciune Îi voi da slavă.
translations.grk: Ἔδωκε Κύριος γλῶσσάν μοι μισθόν μου, καὶ ἐν αὐτῇ αἰνέσω αὐτόν.

verses.geez: ቅረቡ፡ ኀቤየ፡ አብዳን፡ ወትኅደሩ፡ ውስተ፡ ቤተ፡ ጥበብ።
verses.translation: Draw near unto me, ye unlearned, and dwell in the house of learning.

translations.lxx: Draw near unto me, ye unlearned, and dwell in the house of learning.
translations.ron: Că am cugetat ca s-o urmez şi am râvnit binele şi nu mă voi ruşina.
translations.grk: Ἐγγίσατε πρὸς μὲ ἀπαίδευτοι, καὶ αὐλίσθητε ἐν οἴκῳ παιδείας.

verses.geez: በእፎ፡ ኀጣእክምዋ፡ ንግሩ፡ እንበይነ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ወነፍስክሙኒ፡ ጸምአት፡ ፈድፋደ።
verses.translation: Wherefore are ye slow, and what say ye of these things, seeing your souls are very thirsty?

translations.lxx: Wherefore are ye slow, and what say ye of these things, seeing your souls are very thirsty?
translations.ron: Foarte s-a nevoit sufletul meu pentru ea şi întru toată fapta mea sârguitor am fost.
translations.grk: Διότι ὑστερεῖτε ἐν τούτοις, καὶ αἱ ψυχαὶ ὑμῶν διψῶσι σφόδρα;

verses.geez: ወከሠትኩ፡ አፉየ፡ ወነገርኩ፡ ወአጥ[ርይዋ]፡ ለክሙ፡ እንበለ፡ ሤጥ።
verses.translation: I opened my mouth, and said, Buy her for yourselves without money.

translations.lxx: I opened my mouth, and said, Buy her for yourselves without money.
translations.ron: Mâinile mele le-am întins spre înălţime şi, când n-am ştiut-o, m-am tânguit.
translations.grk: Ἤνοιξα τὸ στὸμα μου, καὶ ἐλάλησα, κτήσασθε ἑαυτοῖς ἄνευ ἀργυριου.

verses.geez: አትሕቱ፡ ክሳደክሙ፡ ወተሰክምዋ፡ ጾራ፡ ወትትወከፍ፡ ነፍስክሙ፡ ጥበበ፡ ቅሩብ፡ ውእቱ፡ ረኪቦታ።
verses.translation: Put your neck under the yoke, and let your soul receive instruction: she is hard at hand to find.

translations.lxx: Put your neck under the yoke, and let your soul receive instruction: she is hard at hand to find.
translations.ron: Sufletul meu l-am îndreptat la ea şi, întru curăţie stând, inima mea mi-am lipit de ea din început.
translations.grk: Τὸν τράχηλον ὑμῶν ὑπόθετε ὑπὸ ζυγὸν, καὶ ἐπιδεξάσθω ἡ ψυχὴ ὑμῶν παιδείαν, ἐγγύς ἐστιν εὑρεῖν αὐτήν.

verses.geez: ናሁ፡ ርእዩ፡ በአዕይንቲክሙ፡ ከመ፡ ውኁደ፡ ጻመውኩ፡ ወብዙኀ፡ ዕረፍተ፡ ረከብኩ፡ ሊተ።
verses.translation: Behold with your eyes, how that I have had but little labour, and have gotten unto me much rest.

translations.lxx: Behold with your eyes, how that I have had but little labour, and have gotten unto me much rest.
translations.ron: Pentru aceea nu mă voi lipsi de ea.
translations.grk: Ἴδετε ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς ὑμῶν ὅτι ὀλίγον ἐκοπίασα, καὶ εὗρον ἐμαυτῷ πολλὴν ἀνάπαυσιν.

verses.geez: አብ[ድር]ዋ፡ ለጥበብ፡ እምነ፡ ብዙኀ፡ ወርቅ፡ ዘአልቦ፡ ኈልቈ፡ አጥ[ርይ]ዋ፡ ለክሙ።
verses.translation: Get learning with a great sum of money, and get much gold by her.

translations.lxx: Get learning with a great sum of money, and get much gold by her.
translations.ron: Şi lăuntrul meu s-a tulburat căutând-o, pentru aceea bună comoară mi-am agonisit.
translations.grk: Μετάσχετε παιδείας ἐν πολλῷ ἀριθμῷ ἀργυρίου, καὶ πολὺν χρυσὸν κτήσασθε ἐν αὐτῇ.

verses.geez: ወ[ትትፌሣሕ፡ ነፍስክሙ፡]፡ በምሕረቱ፡ ወኢትኅፈሩ፡ አእኵቶቶ።
verses.translation: Let your soul rejoice in his mercy, and be not ashamed of his praise.

translations.lxx: Let your soul rejoice in his mercy, and be not ashamed of his praise.
translations.ron: Mi-a dat Domnul drept plată limba şi cu ea Îl voi lăuda.
translations.grk: Εὐφρανθείη ἡ ψυχὴ ὑμῶν ἐν τῷ ἐλέει αὐτοῦ, καὶ μὴ αἰσχυνθείητε ἐν αἰνέσει αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ግበሩ፡ ግብረክሙ፡ እንበለ፡ ይብጻሕ፡ ዕድሜሁ፡ ከመ፡ የሀብክሙ፡ ዕሴተክሙ፡ በጊዜሁ።
verses.translation: Work your work betimes, and in his time he will give you your reward.

translations.lxx: Work your work betimes, and in his time he will give you your reward.
translations.ron: Apropiaţi-vă către mine, cei neînvăţaţi, şi rămâneţi în casa învăţăturii!
translations.grk: Ἐργάζεσθε τὸ ἔργον ὑμῶν πρὸ καιροῦ, καὶ δώσει τὸν μισθὸν ὑμῶν ἐν καιρῷ αὐτοῦ.
